fields.description: Fix the database export recipe to use the renamed task_deps table.

fields.title: Add --watch auto-restart flag to endless serve
fields.description: Add a --watch flag to endless serve that restarts the server gracefully when its binary is updated.

fields.title: Accept prefixed task IDs everywhere in the CLI

fields.context: Currently --parent and possibly others only accept integers.

fields.description: Add a declined task status with a decline command that requires a reason, and an outcome field on tasks that can be set at completion.

fields.description: Improve table-recreate migrations so they tolerate stale temp tables left by a prior run and conflicts with concurrent sessions.

fields.description: Fix the task next and task recent queries to select the tier, so their tables can show it.

fields.title: Fix task next to order by phase, status, then tier
fields.description: Fix task next to order by phase, then status, then tier, then recency, and leave in-progress and verify tasks out of its results.
fields.context: Current ordering is status > phase > updated_at.
fields.analysis: Also remove in_progress and verify from next results — those belong in task active.

fields.description: Add a task active command listing in-progress and verify tasks, the work you are currently responsible for.
fields.analysis: Separates 'what am I working on' (active) from 'what should I pick up' (next).

fields.description: Update the web dashboard backlog to use the same sort order as task next.
fields.notes:
Once CLI task next ordering is settled (phase > status > tier),

Hold off until CLI ordering is verified.

fields.description: Fix the task detail pane metadata to list ID first, show tier, and color labels dimmer than values, matching the CLI's style.

fields.title: Add CHECK constraint tying completed_at to completed status
fields.description: Add a constraint to the tasks table so a completion time can only be set when status is completed.
Change the default task list output from the tree to a flat table sorted by ID, with a --tree flag for the tree view.

fields.description: Migrate Endless to an event-sourced architecture with per-project event logs and SQLite as a rebuildable projection, in stages.
fields.analysis:
# Where the rebuild work moved (2026-08-25)

This epic held the April five-stage design. The rebuild-reliability half of it
is owned by **E-1935**, filed in August for exactly that, and the measured state
of `rebuild-db --confirm` — the full transitive FK closure, the four gaps and
their owners, and the ordering constraint on `sessions.task_id` — lives in
E-1935's analysis rather than being duplicated here.

E-1041, E-2062 and E-1728 moved to E-1935 with it. E-894 and its subtree moved
to E-1486, the port epic, being port work rather than event-sourcing work.

What remains here is the design-stage work: E-806, E-809, E-810, E-813, E-814,
E-816, E-817, plus E-910 and E-914.

## From the description

Per-project .endless/events.jsonl + global changelog repo, with SQLite as rebuildable projection. 5-stage migration.

fields.description: Generate Markdown files on disk from ledger content, and keep them in sync, when an external tool Endless works alongside requires them.
fields.notes:
Parked.

Revive against a concrete external tool, which will specify the requirement better than this placeholder.
fields.analysis: Generation and sync only — the event-sourced document entity this epic originally proposed is obsolete, since brainstorm tasks took over the evolving-design role documents were meant to fill.

fields.description: Implement a Go package that serializes hybrid logical clock timestamps as strings that sort lexicographically and stay human-readable.
fields.analysis:
Go package at internal/kairos/.

Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.SSSSSS-XXXX-NNN. Node ID per-installation stored in ~/.config/endless/node_id. Build inside Endless, extract as standalone package later.

fields.description: Define the fixed event envelope and the initial closed set of task, dependency, session, and project event kinds, stored in per-machine segment files.
fields.analysis:
Line-delimited JSON. Initial task/dep/session/project event kinds including revisit status and tags. Events stored in segmented files per node: .endless/events/events-{node_id}-{seq}.jsonl.

Each machine writes only to its own segments; git merge adds files, never line conflicts.

fields.description: Implement Go subcommands that append events to per-machine segment files, with the Python CLI calling them while the database stays authoritative.
fields.analysis:
Python CLI shells out to Go for all event writes — single implementation, no format divergence. Writes to .endless/events/events-{node_id}-{seq}.jsonl. Rotation when segment exceeds threshold.

DB remains authoritative in Stage 1.

Enables sqlc from day one.

fields.description: Make the user config directory optionally a git repo holding cross-project events, synced across machines with git pull and push.
fields.analysis:
No separate changelog repo.

Cross-project events (project registered, cross-project deps) go here. .gitignore excludes endless.db (rebuildable projection) and local cache files. Multi-machine sync via git pull/push in this directory.

fields.description: Build a deterministic projection engine and a rebuild command that recreate the SQLite database from event logs, validated against the current database.
fields.analysis:
Given same events, any machine produces same DB state.

Implement endless rebuild-db.

Validate projection matches current DB.

fields.title: Make event logs authoritative over SQLite
fields.description: Make event logs authoritative: every write goes through the Go event writer first, and SQLite becomes a cache updated by projection.
fields.analysis: Projection updates SQLite incrementally as side effect. Python CLI is fully dependent on Go for writes. DB becomes a cache. endless rebuild-db supported for disaster recovery.

fields.description: Implement a compact command that merges old event segments into a local, uncommitted state file for faster replay.
fields.analysis:
Local-only operation, not committed to git.

Never modifies git-committed segment files. Old segments optionally prunable after checkpoint, but that's a future optimization.

fields.description: Migrate task ordering from integer sort order to lexicographic rank strings, so a task can be inserted between two others without renumbering.
fields.analysis:
Use morikuni/go-lexorank.

Insertion between two tasks without renumbering.

Background rebalance pass.

fields.description: Refactor the catch-all task text field into separate plan, acceptance, design, and notes fields, moving existing text into plan.
fields.analysis: Each gets own event kind. Migration: existing text → plan field, others empty.

fields.title: Implement typed task dependency model
fields.description: Implement a task dependency model with blocks, parent-child and related types, including cross-project dependencies, and use its graph when task next picks work.
fields.analysis: dep.created/dep.removed events. Cross-project deps via global ID. Dependency graph in projection. endless task next uses graph + tier + phase + status.

fields.title: Implement close-time gates for task completion
fields.description: Implement pluggable close-time gates, such as file exists, tests pass, branch merged, children closed and human verified, that block closing a task with a clear error.
fields.analysis: Gates block close with clear error.

fields.title: Handle multi-agent write conflicts
fields.description: Handle conflicting writes from concurrent agents by resolving them deterministically at projection time, parking invariant violations as conflict records, and surfacing those for resolution.
fields.context: Concurrent agents can write conflicting state.

fields.description: Implement a workflow that parks invariant violations as conflict records, surfaces them in the dashboard, CLI and MCP, and resolves each with a new event.
fields.analysis: Surface in dashboard. Expose via CLI + MCP. AI proposes resolution or escalates. Resolution is a new event.

fields.title: Implement paired local and global task identifiers
fields.description: Implement paired task identifiers: a short local ID for humans and a content-hash global ID for machines, mapped one-to-one, with cross-repo dependencies using the global ID.
fields.analysis: E-47 for humans, SHA-256 prefix for machines. 1:1 mapping in projection. Cross-repo deps use global ID.

fields.title: Build a hook adaptor layer decoupled from Claude Code
fields.description: Build Endless's own hook vocabulary plus a Claude Code adaptor that translates into it, opening the way to adaptors for other agent tools.
fields.analysis:
Claude-Code-specific adaptor translates.

Opens path to Codex/Cursor/Gemini adaptors.

fields.title: Implement an import-only Beads backend
fields.description: Implement an import-only Beads backend that imports all Beads tasks into Endless as events by shelling out to the bd CLI.
fields.analysis:
Shell out to bd --json. Import all tasks via bd list. Emit task.imported_from_backend events.

Optional history synthesis from git log of issues.jsonl.

fields.description: Add two-way sync for the Beads backend: push compatible events out, pull changes in with loop prevention, and queue offline changes for retry.
fields.analysis: Outbound push of compatible events. Inbound pull with loop prevention via endless_origin correlation token. Offline queue with retry.

fields.title: Show backend sync degradation in the dashboard
fields.description: Show in the dashboard which data is Endless-only versus synced to a backend, with status overlays and reports of what did not sync.

fields.title: Design a document entity schema with ordered sections
fields.description: Design a document entity schema with stable identifiers, whose sections also have stable identifiers and sortable string positions for ordering.
fields.analysis: Stable local_id + global_id. Sections with stable identifiers, Lexorank positions. documents + document_sections tables in projection.

fields.description: Implement events for creating, editing, moving and archiving documents and their sections, and a projection that builds each document with ordered sections.
fields.analysis:
doc.created, doc.section_added/updated/renamed/moved/removed, doc.archived.

Cached in SQLite.

fields.title: Build a review step for regenerated document sections
fields.description: Build a review step for document regeneration: stage proposed section replacements without applying them, show the diff, then apply on accept or keep the original on decline.
fields.analysis:
doc.section_replacement_proposed stages content without applying. Dashboard shows diff. Accept → doc.section_updated. Decline → original preserved.

Mirrors verify/declined.

fields.title: Surface conflicting concurrent edits to document sections
fields.description: Surface concurrent edits to the same document section for three-way merge review, and structural conflicts such as delete versus update as pending items.
fields.analysis:
Structural conflicts (delete vs update) as pending items.

Same pattern as task conflicts.

fields.description: Build the endless doc commands to add and show documents, add and update sections, apply from a file, and view history, with idempotent machine-parseable output.
fields.analysis: Idempotent, machine-parseable output for Claude Code sessions.

fields.title: Build a command to apply chat-edited markdown to a doc
fields.description: Build endless doc apply-from-chat, which compares a markdown file to the current document and records section-level changes for the differences.
fields.context: Medium-term Claude web bridge.
fields.analysis: ~few hundred lines of Go.

fields.description: Add MCP tools to list documents, read a document or section, propose section updates or replacements, and add or remove sections.
fields.analysis: Narrower than CLI to steer AI toward section-level ops.

fields.title: Add document import from markdown files
fields.description: Add an endless doc import command that parses a markdown file into a document with one section per heading.
fields.analysis: Parse markdown, create doc entity, emit section events per header. Configurable: rendered file vs Endless-only.

fields.description: Omit declined tasks, like completed ones, from task list's default output, showing them only with --all.
fields.notes: Now excludes both unless --all is used.

fields.description: Add a --phase flag to task update so a task's phase can be changed after creation.
fields.context: Phase can be set at creation (task add --phase) but cannot be changed after.

fields.title: Let channel connect auto-detect the active beacon
fields.description: Let endless channel connect run with no arguments and auto-detect the project's active beacon, requiring an ID only when several exist, with clearer not-found errors.
fields.context:
When a session runs 'endless channel beacon', the instructions tell other sessions to run 'endless channel connect <id>'.

The hex ID is easy to mis-copy.
fields.analysis:
Changes: (1) Beacon output should show the channel ID on its own line but simplify the connect instruction to just 'endless channel connect' (no args).

Only require an ID when multiple beacons exist. (3) Improve error message to distinguish 'not found' from 'not in beacon state'.

fields.title: Design ADRs as a document type
fields.description: Design architecture decision records as a document type with standard sections (context, decision, consequences, status), task references and the proposal and review workflow.
fields.context: ADRs (Architecture Decision Records) are a natural document type.

fields.title: Validate titles passed to task update --title
fields.description: Validate that titles passed to task update --title start with a registered verb, rejecting any that do not.
fields.notes: Already implemented — validate_title() is called in update_plan() at line 1204 of task_cmd.py.
fields.context: Verified: 'endless task update E-842 --title "broken title"' correctly rejects non-verb starts.

fields.title: Allow multiple values in the task list --status filter
fields.description: Allow the task list --status filter to accept comma-separated values, such as needs_plan,ready,in_progress.
fields.context: Currently only accepts a single value.

fields.title: Fix hook errors to always exit non-zero
fields.description: Fix hook error handling so every failure, including session tracking and activity recording, exits non-zero and Claude stops to show the user instead of silently continuing.
fields.context:
E-708 incorrectly classified session tracking, activity recording, and other DB operations as 'non-fatal' (log to stderr but continue).

The original bug that triggered E-708 was exactly this kind of 'non-fatal' error causing lost data.
fields.analysis: The user must approve any bypass — the AI must not silently degrade.

fields.title: Record hook and channel errors in log files
fields.description: Record hook and channel errors in log files under the Endless config directory as well as on stderr.
fields.notes:
Implemented as part of E-844 —

hook and channel errors now log to ~/.config/endless/log/hook.log and channel.log respectively, using io.MultiWriter for both stderr and file output.

fields.description: Add an assumed status for tasks believed complete but not yet verified, and rename the completed status to confirmed across the codebase.
fields.analysis: Pre-1.0 with no external users, so clean break.

fields.title: Allow multiple task IDs on single-task commands
fields.description: Allow commands that take one task ID, such as update, show, start and move, to accept several IDs and apply the same operation to each.
fields.analysis:
Covers: task update, task confirm, task assume, task remove, task start, task show, task move.

Example: 'endless task assume E-708 E-730 E-739'.

fields.title: Add --blocked-by flag to task update
fields.description: Add a --blocked-by flag to task update that records which task blocks this one when setting it blocked, queryable by the blocking task.
fields.notes: Note: E-812 (full dependency model) might obsolete this, but it's useful now before that lands.
fields.analysis: Stores the blocking task ID as metadata. Queryable so we can answer 'what's blocked by E-799'.

fields.title: Add integration tests for Beads JSON output
fields.description: Add integration tests that check the JSON structure the Beads bd CLI outputs, so breaking changes in it are caught early.
fields.context: bd CLI output format is not under our control.

fields.title: Build document list and detail views in the dashboard
fields.description: Build a document list in the dashboard project view and a detail view with rendered sections, edit history, and pending proposals and conflicts to accept or decline.
fields.analysis: Read-centric with accept/decline controls.

fields.title: Implement basic task dependency tracking in the CLI
fields.description: Implement lightweight CLI commands to record which tasks block which, list a task's dependencies, show blockers in task show, and filter task list by blocked or blocking.
fields.notes:
before E-812 lands the full event-sourced model.

E-812 will replace this but the data can migrate.
fields.analysis: Uses existing task_deps table. Commands: endless task block <id> --by <id>, endless task deps <id>. Show blockers in task show output. Filter: endless task list --blocked, --blocking.

fields.description: Show a task's blocked-by and blocking dependencies in the web dashboard detail pane, matching task show in the CLI.
fields.context: CLI now shows blocked-by and blocking in task show output.

fields.title: Add an obsolete status for overtaken tasks
fields.description: Add an obsolete status, distinct from declined, for tasks made irrelevant by other changes rather than actively rejected.
fields.context: Needed for tasks like E-714 that were superseded.
fields.analysis: Declined = active decision not to do. Obsolete = passively made irrelevant by other changes.

fields.title: Make tier 1 tasks start ready, never needing a plan
fields.description: Make tier 1 (automatic) tasks unable to have needs_plan status: enforce it in the schema, set ready automatically on add, and fix existing data.
fields.analysis: Tier 1 (auto) tasks cannot have needs_plan status — they don't need a plan by definition.

fields.description: Clear a task's tier to n/a when it reaches verify, confirmed, assumed, declined or obsolete, and keep --tier none matching only untriaged tasks.
fields.context: Prevents stale tier labels on finished tasks.
fields.analysis: Tier 0 displays as 'n/a'. --tier none filters for NULL only (untriaged), not 0.

fields.title: Build session conversation history
fields.description: Build capture of session conversation content using hooks, with CLI commands to list, show and reimport history and a web page showing each session's messages.
fields.analysis: CLI: session history, session list, session reimport. Web: /sessions/<id> with reverse-chron, collapsed tools, lazy loading.

fields.description: Capture images referenced in session transcripts by copying them into the project's .endless/images before their temp files disappear, and clean up old ones.
fields.context: Images in transcripts reference temp files that get cleaned up.
fields.analysis: Add cleanup for images older than N days.

fields.title: Add a live session viewer command
fields.description: Add endless session watch, which continuously shows a session's new messages as they arrive, like tail -f, for use in a pane beside Claude.
fields.context: Run in a tmux pane alongside Claude for real-time conversation review. Similar to claude-history's continuous sync but integrated with Endless.

fields.title: Generate session recaps in the background
fields.description: Generate per-session recap summaries from Claude Code transcripts in the background, refreshing each after a number of new user messages.

fields.title: Add a --text flag to task add
fields.description: Add a --text flag to endless task add that sets the task's body from a file at creation, as task update already can.
fields.context: endless task add only takes --description (short string); body-from-file requires a separate task update --text call.

fields.description: Split database migrations into automatic additive ones and table rebuilds that run only via an explicit endless db migrate, which backs up the database first.
fields.context: Fixes chronic data loss from rebuild migrations running on every hook fire.
fields.analysis: Automatic migrations: only ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN, UPDATE, CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS. Table rebuilds (CHECK changes, column drops) require explicit 'endless db migrate' with auto-backup of DB file first.

fields.description: Implement one schema-versioned migration runner that applies migrations only when the database version is behind, with an explicit migrate command that backs up first.
fields.analysis:
(1) _schema_version table with single integer, (2) one migration runner (not both Go and Python), (3) migrations run only when version is behind, (4) 'endless db migrate' command with auto-backup, (5) no table rebuilds in auto-migration.

shipping without proper migrations risks corrupting user databases.

fields.description: Add a --limit option to task search, matching task next and session search.
fields.context: Got 'No such option: --limit' when trying 'endless task search migration --limit 10'.
fields.analysis: Should match the pattern used by task next and session search.

fields.title: Add a busy timeout to all SQLite connections
fields.description: Add a busy timeout to every Go and Python SQLite connection so concurrent hook processes wait for a lock instead of failing immediately.
fields.analysis: Add PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000 to both Go (monitor/db.go) and Python (db.py) DB connections.

fields.description: Add a zsh/bash prompt hook that finds sessions needing a recap and runs endless session recap for them in the background.
fields.analysis: Also: session list inline fallback generates one recap per call for the most stale flagged session.

fields.title: Hide sessions created by recap generation
fields.description: Hide the sessions that endless session recap creates by calling claude -p, so they don't clutter the session list.
fields.context:
Each 'endless session recap' call creates a new session via claude -p hooks.

These clutter the session list.
fields.analysis: Options: auto-hide sessions with <= 2 messages in ended state, or find a way to run claude -p without triggering Endless hooks.

fields.description: Design how sessions recorded under a project's old directory names get mapped to the current project after it is renamed.
fields.context:
Projects get renamed (h2s → h24p → h2pp). Claude's JSONL paths encode the old name, so sessions from old names need to map to the current project.

Impacts session import, project reconciliation, and dashboard.
fields.analysis: Need to discuss: alias table? Rename history? Auto-detect from git remote? Heuristic matching?

fields.title: Hide error sessions at ingestion time
fields.description: Hide sessions whose summary is an error, such as 'Not logged in', when they are ingested, not only when they are displayed.
fields.notes: Sessions with error summaries like 'Not logged in' are now auto-hidden at ingestion time in both Go transcript parser and Python reimport. Previously only filtered at display time.

fields.description: Migrate session recap generation from Python to Go so the prompt hook can trigger it natively without shelling out to Python.
fields.context: Session recap (endless session recap) is currently Python-only, calling claude -p via subprocess.
fields.analysis: The Go version goes in internal/monitor/ or cmd/endless-hook/.

fields.description: Fix the hook failing in unregistered project directories, either by auto-registering the project or by failing with clear instructions to register it.
fields.context: ensureAnonymousProject uses status='anonymous' which is not in the CHECK constraint.
fields.analysis: Options: (1) auto-register as active with inferred metadata, (2) fail with clear instructions to run 'endless register'. Need to decide which behavior is correct.
